classification_rule: a scenario is a MECHANISM_FAILURE only if the recorded human judgment says so; none does. Each entry quotes the recorded human text it rests on (human_basis) and the quotation is checked against the human record

development_status.meaning: development only; NOT production, NOT clinical validation, NOT resident deployment

faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-01: Human review totals: ACCEPT 1, ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATION 3, RECALIBRATE 0, REJECT 1. The single REJECT is a clinically inappropriate vasopressor intervention in an already severely hypertensive pulmonary-edema patient: the review is NOT to be interpreted as failure of the common tone mechanism.
faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-02: The common vascular-tone pathway is ACCEPTABLE FOR DEVELOPMENT for appropriately selected supportive vasopressor contexts.
faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-03: CENTER_REFERENCE is promoted to COMMON_TONE_DEVELOPMENT_SNAPSHOT_V1. Reason: accepted in the low-tone positive control; acceptable with limitations in hemorrhagic and obstructive shock; no scenario requested global tone recalibration; the ACS limitation is pump-context dependent; the pulmonary-edema rejection reflects an inappropriate intervention context. A DEVELOPMENT snapshot, NOT a clinical calibration, production validation or resident approval.
faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-04: LOW and HIGH remain TEST_WITNESS_ONLY. No further calibration cycle unless future evidence requires it.
faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-05: COMMON_TONE_PUMP_DEPENDENCE_NOT_YET_VALIDATED persists as a MONITORED DEVELOPMENT LIMITATION: it blocks educational promotion of vasopressor behaviour in pump-limited families; it does NOT block continued development of the common tone mechanism.
faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-06: The hypertensive pulmonary-edema scenario is classified INAPPROPRIATE_INTERVENTION_CONTEXT and, optionally, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_CANDIDATE for future management-reasoning work. Its physiology is not altered so that the intervention appears beneficial.
faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-07: CONSCIOUSNESS_UNDER_TONE_UNRESOLVED persists: pressure-derived consciousness interpretation under active tone support stays blocked.
faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-08: TITRATION_AND_STOP_NOT_SUPPORTED persists as the NEXT HIGH-PRIORITY MANAGEMENT GAP; the next implementation target after ratification is norepinephrine rate change / titration / stop semantics. NOT implemented in this ratification package unless explicitly authorized later.
faculty_decisions.FD-TONE-RATIFY-09: No sensitivity review is required for the current development decision; the LOW/HIGH review remains optional future work and ratification is not delayed for it.

COMMON_TONE_PUMP_DEPENDENCE_NOT_YET_VALI.what_it_is: the output cost of tone is one sensitivity for every pump and volume (a certified limitation of the pathway); how the pressure response should depend on the state of the pump is not validated, and the ACS review (not hypotensive, pump-limited) is where it showed

blocks: pressure-derived consciousness interpretation under active tone support
any consciousness authority or resident-visible interpretation under active tone support
does_not_block: continued development of the common tone mechanism
CONSCIOUSNESS_UNDER_TONE_UNRESOLVED.what_it_is: the consciousness readings are taken from the pressure, so with support they read BETTER while output and delivery are lower (a certified limitation of the pathway); the development mapping refuses the support on an Amendment-2 consciousness witness

blocks: any claim that a norepinephrine rate change or a stop is represented
TITRATION_AND_STOP_NOT_SUPPORTED.what_it_is: only a single start of norepinephrine at a fixed rate in mcg/min is mapped; an adjustment, a stop, a weight-based dose and any later start are declared gaps (runtime_tone_support)

negative_control.future_use: a negative-control management scenario (a vasopressor ordered for a profoundly hypertensive patient with acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema)
negative_control.why_not_unavailable: the action is inappropriate in this context, not in general: the common mechanism must keep representing it so that the inappropriate order has a consequence to be judged

next_management_priority.first_step_when_authorized: an audit of what the engine mirrors for a rate change and a stop, of how the writer represents a rate that changes over time, and of what each ordering means for the support the offset constant already decays
next_management_priority.through: the SAME common writer of the common vasoconstrictor support

model_analysis.consequence: no change to T, to the pump coupling or to any parameter follows from it (FD-TONE-RATIFY-06)
model_analysis.reading: at minute 30 the SAME mechanism gives the same relative response in pulmonary edema, gastrointestinal bleed, asthma and opioid (pressure ratio 1.192661) and a slightly higher one in ACS and pulmonary embolism; the absolute rise is largest in pulmonary edema (28.9 mmHg of mean pressure) because its baseline is the highest (150 mmHg), not because the mechanism acts differently there. Changing T to shrink that rise would change every family, to look better in a patient who should not receive the drug

reading.direction_and_timing: Q1 Expected and Q2 Plausible: the faculty found the direction and the timing of the response right
reading.magnitude_management_and_educational_ris: Q3 Too large, Q4 Incoherent and Q5 Yes were given with the faculty's own explanation: the patient is already profoundly hypertensive with acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema and the intervention drives pressure further into an extreme range

pulmonary_edema_audit.why_not: the faculty stated that the REJECT is primarily a judgment of the management context and educational use, that it is NOT by itself evidence that the common mechanism needs global recalibration, and that T is not to be retuned to make the intervention look acceptable in a patient who should not receive it; no scenario was RECALIBRATE

ratified: COMMON VASCULAR TONE PATHWAY (PHASE2_AMENDMENT_3 vasoconstrictor support, norepinephrine start at a fixed rate as its first writer)
ratified_for: DEVELOPMENT EXPERIMENTS under appropriately selected supportive vasopressor contexts

human_basis: The pressure response is directionally and temporally defensible.
Do NOT globally recalibrate the tone pathway from this scenario.
ACS.meaning: a pump-context limitation of what the pressure response means in a pump-limited patient who is not hypotensive; not a tone-pathway recalibration

human_basis: Norepinephrine produces an appropriate early pressure response.
must not be interpreted as correction of underlying volume loss
FR-F.meaning: an educational caution about how the pressure improvement is read, not a defect of the mechanism

human_basis: The pressure response is clinically defensible as temporary hemodynamic support in obstructive shock.
It must not imply correction of the pulmonary vascular obstruction.
PE.meaning: an educational caution: temporary support is not correction of the obstruction

human_basis: The pressure rise itself is physiologically understandable.
This REJECT is primarily a judgment of the MANAGEMENT CONTEXT / EDUCATIONAL USE of this intervention.
It is NOT, by itself, evidence that the common vascular-tone mechanism requires global recalibration.
Do NOT retune T merely to make norepinephrine look acceptable in a patient who should not receive it.
PULM-EDEMA.meaning: the faculty rejected giving this vasopressor to this patient, not the way the common mechanism responds to it

human_basis: The response is a clean development-positive control.
SYNTH.meaning: the mechanism does what it should in the one state built to test it, and does not return the system to its original baseline

scenario_limitation_labels.COMMON_TONE_PRESSURE_BENEFIT_MUST_NOT_IM: PE: temporary hemodynamic support in obstructive shock is not correction of the obstruction
FR-F: the pressure benefit attenuates while the hemorrhage is untreated and is not correction of the volume loss
